answers.q1: uv (lockfile uv.lock, config in pyproject.toml). CI installs with: `uv sync --no-dev --group tests --extra all`. For a full dev setup, use `uv sync --extra all`, which includes the default dev groups. This is what the pre-commit CI job runs, with `--locked` added.
answers.q2: `uv run bash scripts/test.sh`. This runs `PYTHONPATH=./docs_src pytest -n auto --dist loadgroup tests scripts/tests/`. CI uses `uv run --no-sync bash scripts/test-cov.sh`, which adds coverage.
answers.q4: CI runs pre-commit through prek, limited to the changed files: `uv run prek run --from-ref origin/master --to-ref HEAD --show-diff-on-failure`. To run all hooks on every file, use `uv run prek run --all-files`. The hooks include ruff check, ruff format, mypy, ty, typos, zizmor and the file-hygiene checks. The equivalent direct commands are `uv run ruff check fastapi tests docs_src scripts`, `uv run ruff format fastapi tests --check`, `uv run mypy fastapi`, and `uv run ty check`. The last four are what `bash scripts/lint.sh` runs.
